questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the basic unit of length?
explanation: Metre is correct - M-E-T-R-E. A metre is the basic unit of length in the metric system.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the unit used for very small lengths?
explanation: Centimetre is correct - C-E-N-T-I-M-E-T-R-E. A centimetre is one hundredth of a metre.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the unit for measuring mass?
explanation: Kilogram is correct - K-I-L-O-G-R-A-M. A kilogram is the basic unit of mass in the metric system.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the unit for measuring liquid?
explanation: Litre is correct - L-I-T-R-E. A litre is the unit of volume used for measuring liquid.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the measurement of how heavy something is?
explanation: Weight is correct - W-E-I-G-H-T. Weight is the measure of how heavy an object is.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the extent of something from end to end?
explanation: Length is correct - L-E-N-G-T-H. Length is the measurement of something from one end to the other.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the distance around the outside of a shape?
explanation: Perimeter is correct - P-E-R-I-M-E-T-E-R. Perimeter is the total distance around the outside of a shape.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the space a shape covers?
explanation: Area is correct - A-R-E-A. Area is the measurement of the surface covered by a two-dimensional shape.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the amount of space inside a 3D object?
explanation: Volume is correct - V-O-L-U-M-E. Volume is the amount of three-dimensional space enclosed within a shape.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one part out of ten?
explanation: Tenth is correct - T-E-N-T-H. Tenth means one of ten equal parts of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a very small unit of time?
explanation: Second is correct - S-E-C-O-N-D. A second is the basic unit of time, equal to one sixtieth of a minute.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one thousandth of a kilogram?
explanation: Gram is correct - G-R-A-M. A gram is one thousandth of a kilogram.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of measuring how hot or cold something is?
explanation: Temperature is correct - T-E-M-P-E-R-A-T-U-R-E. Temperature is the measurement of how hot or cold something is.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one part out of a hundred?
explanation: Percent is correct - P-E-R-C-E-N-T. Percent means one part in every hundred.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a unit of angle equal to one ninetieth of a right angle?
explanation: Degree is correct - D-E-G-R-E-E. A degree is the unit used to measure angles and temperature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the distance from the center to the edge of a circle?
explanation: Radius is correct - R-A-D-I-U-S. The radius is the distance from the center of a circle to its edge.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the distance across a circle through its center?
explanation: Diameter is correct - D-I-A-M-E-T-E-R. Diameter is the length of a straight line from one side of a circle to the other through the center.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a unit equal to 1000 metres?
explanation: Kilometre is correct - K-I-L-O-M-E-T-R-E. A kilometre is a unit of length equal to 1000 metres.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a unit of weight equal to 1000 grams?
explanation: Kilogram is correct - K-I-L-O-G-R-A-M. A kilogram is the base unit of mass equal to 1000 grams.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one-hundredth of a metre?
explanation: Centimetre is correct - C-E-N-T-I-M-E-T-R-E. A centimetre is one hundredth of a metre.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of measuring how long ago something happened?
explanation: Duration is correct - D-U-R-A-T-I-O-N. Duration is the length of time something continues or exists.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a unit for measuring electric power?
explanation: Watt is correct - W-A-T-T. A watt is the unit of power, named after James Watt.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of measuring how deep something is?
explanation: Depth is correct - D-E-P-T-H. Depth is the measurement of how deep something is.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the total of numbers added together?
explanation: Summation is correct - S-U-M-M-A-T-I-O-N. Summation is the process of adding a set of numbers together to get a total.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of finding the middle value?
explanation: Average is correct - A-V-E-R-A-G-E. An average is a number calculated to represent the typical value of a set.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the amount of something held?
explanation: Capacity is correct - C-A-P-A-C-I-T-Y. Capacity is the maximum amount that something can contain or hold.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a system of measurement based on tens?
explanation: Decimal is correct - D-E-C-I-M-A-L. The decimal system is a number system based on the number ten.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one part of a divided whole?
explanation: Fraction is correct - F-R-A-C-T-I-O-N. A fraction represents part of a whole, written as one number over another.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the number of times something happens per second?
explanation: Frequency is correct - F-R-E-Q-U-E-N-C-Y. Frequency is the rate at which something occurs over a given period.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the unit of measuring electricity?
explanation: Ampere is correct - A-M-P-E-R-E. An ampere is the base unit of electric current in the metric system.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of units used in the metric system?
explanation: Metric is correct - M-E-T-R-I-C. The metric system is a system of measurement based on units of ten.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the number of events in a given amount of time?
explanation: Proportion is correct - P-R-O-P-O-R-T-I-O-N. Proportion is a part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of not rounded to exact value?
explanation: Approximate is correct - A-P-P-R-O-X-I-M-A-T-E. Approximate means close to the actual number, but not completely accurate.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the speed of an object?
explanation: Velocity is correct - V-E-L-O-C-I-T-Y. Velocity is the speed of an object in a specified direction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a measurement expressed as a fraction of 100?
explanation: Percentage is correct - P-E-R-C-E-N-T-A-G-E. A percentage is a proportion expressed as a fraction of 100.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the exactness of a measurement?
explanation: Precision is correct - P-R-E-C-I-S-I-O-N. Precision refers to the exactness or accuracy of a measurement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the difference between the largest and smallest values?
explanation: Range is correct - R-A-N-G-E. Range is the difference between the highest and lowest values in a data set.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the number in the middle of a set of values?
explanation: Median is correct - M-E-D-I-A-N. Median is the middle value in a set of ordered numbers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the most frequently occurring value?
explanation: Mode is correct - M-O-D-E. Mode is the value that appears most often in a set of data.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the result of multiplying a number by itself?
explanation: Squared is correct - S-Q-U-A-R-E-D. Squared means multiplied by itself, used in area and power calculations.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the total of all items added together?
explanation: Aggregate is correct - A-G-G-R-E-G-A-T-E. Aggregate means the total of all items combined together.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of measuring how tall something is?
explanation: Height is correct - H-E-I-G-H-T. Height is the measurement of how tall something is.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of measuring how wide something is?
explanation: Width is correct - W-I-D-T-H. Width is the measurement of how wide something is from one side to the other.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the amount of space between two points?
explanation: Distance is correct - D-I-S-T-A-N-C-E. Distance is the amount of space between two points or places.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the rate at which something moves?
explanation: Speed is correct - S-P-E-E-D. Speed is the rate at which someone or something moves.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one-half of something?
explanation: Half is correct - H-A-L-F. Half is one of two equal parts of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of one-fourth of something?
explanation: Quarter is correct - Q-U-A-R-T-E-R. A quarter is one of four equal parts of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a standard used for comparison?
explanation: Standard is correct - S-T-A-N-D-A-R-D. A standard is an established measure used for comparison.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of finding an answer by calculation?
explanation: Estimation is correct - E-S-T-I-M-A-T-I-O-N. Estimation is the process of calculating an approximate value.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a very large or small written number?
explanation: Notation is correct - N-O-T-A-T-I-O-N. Notation is a system of symbols used to represent numbers or measurements.
